name: Intent Graper
description: Lock the seat to the partner's rhythm so both lances rise and fall on the same beat.

name: Waning Couchrest
description: Read the partner horse's gait by ear and knee so the pair keeps one stride length.

name: Iron Arrestrest
description: Jab the point down the rider's own lane while the partner's lance takes the neighboring one.

name: Iron Lancehead
description: Thrust on a mirrored half-beat so the foe cannot guard against both points together.

name: Aegis Lanceguard
description: Fan a sheet of qi from the shaft to cover the partner's unguarded side.

name: Granite Bellrest
description: Pulse qi through the rein to turn both horses in the same instant onto the same line.

name: Merciless Counterbalance
description: Run both lances into a single wedge with joined qi to drive the foe's line apart.

name: Chimegraper
description: Cross over the partner's path at contact so each rider's guard covers the other's open side.

name: Glint Momentum
description: Gather both riders' qi into one cast and drive twin points into a single mark with the weight of both horses.

name: Might Lanceshaft
description: Rise in the saddle to a hawk's height over the horse's neck to lengthen the downward line.

name: Chimesaddle
description: Read the dip and rise of the basin floor ahead and choose the line the horse will hold.

name: Corroding Shatter
description: Jab the point with a hooked wrist so the barb tears a strap as it comes free.

name: Murk Vamplate
description: Turn the horse along the basin's rim with the shaft covering the open side.

name: Tilthavoc
description: Weight the downward thrust with a pulse of qi so it sinks through plate from above.

name: Inexorable Coronel
description: Throw the shaft before the chest and let qi echo off it to turn a thrust aside.

name: Silt Shatter
description: Lift the horse over a low ledge on the basin rim with a pulse of qi in its stride.

name: Impactruin
description: Cast a mass of qi along the shaft from a height and bring the whole lance down in one cleaving blow.

name: Thornride
description: Cast a net of qi from the shaft round a fleeing rider so the basin rim holds him in.

name: Gust Impact
description: Dive through a massed rank on the lance and open it with the qi released at the instant of contact.

name: Graperblink
description: Enter the charge on one of two parallel lines chosen by a glance at the ground.

name: Revitalizing Lanceshaft
description: Level the point along the left track and hold it there through the opening strides.

name: Ironride
description: Swing the point across from the right track to cut at a foe who faces left.

name: Granite Momentum
description: Flick the rein at the last stride to slide the horse from one track onto the other.

name: Remnant Lancehead
description: Sweep the eyes across both lines at once to mark which one the foe has left open.

name: Rumblevamp
description: Drive the thrust down the open track with qi echoing the first stroke's line.

name: Murk Arrestrest
description: Brush the shaft along the track's edge to sweep off a thrust coming across it.

name: Bowlmettle
description: Press the shaft across both tracks with qi to hold a rider from choosing either.

name: Gnashing Ride
description: Charge along both tracks in turn so the foe cannot tell which will carry the blow.

name: Torrent Coronel
description: Turn off the foe's thrust along the rail and strike back in the same motion down the same line.

name: Rumble Bowl
description: Join the two tracks at the last stride and drive the whole weight of both into a single impact.

name: Intentvamp
description: Breathe out slowly to let the qi field settle evenly over rider, horse and lance.

name: Unerring Graper
description: Hold the gaze on the target through the blue shimmer of the field and keep the aim.

name: Ferocious Bowl
description: Drive the point forward with the field's edge hugging the iron.

name: Evergreen Vamplate
description: Block with the shaft at the point where the field thickens and knock a blade off line.

name: Mightvamp
description: Open the horse's stride to its longest with the field smoothing the ground ahead.

name: Rumbletilt
description: Cloak the point in the field so the thrust gives no glint and no warning before it lands.

name: Evergreen Bellrest
description: Bloom the field outward from the shaft in one pulse to take the force of a blow.

name: Rumble Lanceguard
description: Press the field against a foe's horse so it sidesteps out of line.

name: Siltvamp
description: Wheel the horse through a tight arc with the field cushioning the turn's lean.

name: Rumble Impact
description: Sheathe the whole lance in the field and rush a foe so strike and bore land as one.

name: Toxinsaddle
description: Lay a thread of the field along a lane so the first rider through is thrown by it.

name: Gnashing Blaze Couchrest
description: Draw the whole field into the lance and let it fall on the mark as one blue-edged blow.

name: Lightning Lancehead
description: Hold the horse to a river's even pace for a long approach without tiring it.

name: Vitalsaddle
description: Sway the seat with the horse's motion as with a current so the lance never jolts.

name: Impact Reckoning
description: Strike from the horse's bankside flank with the shaft's full length at a foe on foot.

name: Inexorable Lanceshaft
description: Turn the shaft in a small eddying circle to catch and carry a blade off line.

name: Waning Coronel
description: Sight the target along the shaft the way a rider reads a stream's far bank.

name: Rumble Graper
description: Feed the length of the run into one thrust so the point carries the whole approach.

name: Mayhem Bowl
description: Hook the shaft low behind a rider's leg and drag him back like an undertow.

name: Inexorable Counterbalance
description: Send small rings of qi out from the shaft to break the force of several thrusts.

name: Lanceguard Slipstream
description: Quicken the horse's gallop with a steady qi pulse through the stirrups.

name: Bowlruin
description: Rush forward like a rising flood, sweeping foes aside in front of the point.

name: Grapermettle
description: Spin the shaft in a spiral of qi that coils round a foe's weapon and binds it.

name: Aegis Counterbalance
description: Plant the lance and hold ground against a rush, letting the force spill harmlessly past.

name: Iron Vamplate
description: Gather the whole river's weight into a cast and drive it through a line in one surge.

name: Vital Couchrest
description: Sit the horse with a mastery that lets the whole body disappear behind the lance.

name: Arrestrest Vitality
description: Hold utterly still for one heartbeat before the strike so every sense gathers on the mark.

name: Decimating Tilt
description: Lengthen the thrust past what the arm alone could reach by using the whole leaning body.

name: Equipoise Vamplate
description: Parry a heavy cut with a small turn of the shaft that takes its force without strain.

name: Rumble Shatter
description: Lend a full measure of the rider's reservoir to the point at contact for a deep bore.

name: Healing Bellrest
description: Link rider and horse by a thread of qi so the horse answers before the rein moves.

name: Granite Lanceshaft
description: Hold the shaft crosswise with the body's whole network of qi behind it.

name: Tilt Wrath
description: Charge with every mortal channel open so the strike carries all the body can give.

name: Shaderide
description: Ride along a rank and press it inward with qi at the point until it crowds itself.

name: Decimating Ride
description: Gather the rider's whole network into a cast and thrust past the mortal limit of one blow.

name: Vitalgraper
description: Voice the vow to the wind as the seat settles and the lance finds its rest.

name: Remnant Arrestrest
description: Read the plateau wind on the face and the shaft to know which way the charge will drift.

name: Ride Scourge
description: Jab straight along the sworn bearing without a flicker of the wrist.

name: Flintlike Couchrest
description: Turn the shaft broadside to the wind and a blade together to break both.

name: Pitiless Lancehead
description: Lay the weight of the vow behind the point as qi and drive it through guard and plate.

name: Unrelenting Coronel
description: Fan the shaft in a short arc to raise a veil of gale that turns thrusts.

name: Mightimpact
description: Pull the rein to turn the horse without letting the point's bearing shift.

name: Granite Tilt
description: Rush ahead with the gale behind the sworn lance and cover the last strides at double pace.

name: Shade Counterbalance
description: Hold a foe in place with the gale's pressure along the lance until the vow is kept.

name: Grievous Ride
description: Cast the whole gale into the sworn thrust and let the oath be met in the blow.

name: Tilt Whirlpool
description: Set a pace the plateau floor allows and keep it without checking.

name: Equipoise Graper
description: Couch the lance on a single held breath that carries the oath into the grip.

name: Granite Impact
description: Strike across open air with the shaft's full reach before the foe can close.

name: Vampnerve
description: Raise the shaft into the wind at the plateau's edge to carry a thrust over the head.

name: Veritysaddle
description: Hold the sight on the horizon line to keep the bearing true across a long approach.

name: Bowl Havoc
description: Run the point through a guard with the oath's weight pressing it forward.

name: Facet Lanceguard
description: Shroud the rider in plateau dust stirred up by the shaft to blur the aim of the foe.

name: Equipoise Lanceguard
description: Beat the distance in a steady rhythm along the rein so the horse keeps it unprompted.

name: Sanguine Momentum
description: Strike on the plateau with the oath behind the lance and throw a rider from his saddle.

name: Lot Shatter
description: Lay the shaft across the plateau's narrow edge path and bar riders from passing.

name: Graperhavoc
description: Cast the oath into the iron point and drive it through a shield and the arm behind it.

name: Verity Bellrest
description: Take the bearing before the horse moves and hold the seat so it never drifts from it.

name: Saddleglare
description: Run the horse dead straight along the taken bearing without a weave.

name: Blaze Bellrest
description: Strike with the point exactly on the bearing so the foe's guard is met on its own line.

name: Berserk Momentum
description: Hold the bearing through the thrust with qi so the point stays true through plate.

name: Gustsaddle
description: Angle the shaft across the crosswind to turn a thrust while holding the bearing.

name: Dazzling Vamplate
description: Cut the rein to shift the whole charge one bearing over without losing speed.

name: Might Momentum
description: Rush on the bearing at the head of a great charge so the whole mass follows the point.

name: Fastening Coronel
description: Pin a foe whose bearing has broken by planting the shaft across his path with qi.

name: Iron Shatter
description: Cast the whole charge's bearing into one falling blow from the lance at the line's head.

name: Gust Ride
description: Hold the horse to a pace at the last edge that lets it launch without balking.

name: Radiant Lancehead
description: Settle the seat against the far wind and lock the lance into the rest.

name: Wrathful Tilt
description: Reach for a distant mark with a lunging jab that adds a half-length by the lean.

name: Unconquered Arrestrest
description: Drop the shaft into the still hollow behind a ridge and turn a thrust off it.

name: Beneficent Lanceshaft
description: Sight the lowland below the escarpment and pick the foe worth the descent.

name: Rumble Counterbalance
description: Feed the downhill pull into the thrust so the point pierces plate from speed alone.

name: Aegis Graper
description: Lift the shaft against thin air with qi to turn a thrust from a rider above.

name: Impact Rocketry
description: Gather the reins and leap a narrow ridge cut with a pulse of qi at the take-off.

name: Harnessing Impact
description: Shove the foe's mount sideways on a cliff edge with the flat of the shaft.

name: Iron Coronel
description: Rush off the plateau's lip so the horse's downhill speed carries the lance to its target.

name: Vampblink
description: Leave a wake of gale behind the lance that throws pursuers off their line.

name: Tiltglimmer
description: Cast the lance ahead of its own motion and cross the distance between plateau and foe in a flash.

name: Mightsaddle
description: Hold a long breath on the oath and let it set the grip before the charge.

name: Granite Couchrest
description: Keep a steady rhythm in the reins that matches the pace of the oath.

name: Ironsaddle
description: Strike at the mark named in the oath and nothing near it.

name: Murk Lanceshaft
description: Parry with the shaft held as a bar before the oath-bound body.

name: Verity Lancehead
description: Fix the eye on the sworn foe through the whole field so no other target draws it.

name: Ruinous Bowl
description: Surge the point through a guard with the long oath's persistence behind it.

name: Thornsaddle
description: Raise a barrier of wind along the shaft to bar a blow aimed at the oath-bound.

name: Toxinvamp
description: Hook a foe's weapon with the shaft and bind it for a moment with the oath.

name: Tiltflash
description: Borrow the wind's push to quicken the horse's stride for the final run.

name: Sanguine Vamplate
description: Charge across a field to keep the oath, breaking the foe's line with a single blow.

name: Granite Lanceguard
description: Hold a sworn rank together with a joint field of qi that blunts the foe's push.

name: Ponderous Bowl
description: Coil the wind about the shaft and bind a foe's weapon arm for several heartbeats.

name: Eviscerating Shatter
description: Cast the oath through the lance as the last gust and meet the sworn foe with it.

name: Intent Arrestrest
description: Settle the seat as the oath is spoken and let the lance find its rest.

name: Verity Couchrest
description: Read the plateau wind through a body at its mortal peak and set the line accordingly.

name: Rumble Bellrest
description: Strike at the full reach of arm and shaft toward the sworn mark.

name: Murkgraper
description: Fend off a cut with a short firm turn of the shaft and a settled oath.

name: Ghosting Tilt
description: Hold a pace that the horse can keep to the end of the longest run.

name: Unsparing Ride
description: Lend the reservoir to the point at the oath's mark for a thrust that sinks deep.

name: Unconquered Coronel
description: Bar a blow with the shaft and a wind of qi that stands up against it.

name: Revitalizing Counterbalance
description: Link the oath to the horse by a thread of qi down the rein.

name: Tempered Vamplate
description: Rush with every channel of the body open and the oath behind the point.

name: Strangling Lanceshaft
description: Ride the line's length on a held breath and press it still with qi from the point.

name: Booming Momentum
description: Cast the oath at the mortal ceiling into the lance and meet the foe in a single thrust.
